description:
Priority: P1 (layout/process). Files: spec/** (placeholder .feature files), tests/cucumber/{main.rs,world.rs,steps/mod.rs}, tests/common/{mod.rs,test_app.rs,test_client.rs}, tests/fixtures/.gitkeep, Cargo.toml ([[test]] + cucumber dev-dependency). Reference: aviary (only repo with a working harness).

Problem: The template has a single flat integration test and no spec/, despite its CLAUDE.md preaching "fast, deterministic integration tests" with mocks and the repo shipping a bdd-webserver skill that targets exactly this workflow.

Change:
  - Add the cucumber dev-dependency and `[[test]] name = "cucumber" harness = false` to Cargo.toml.
  - Vendor aviary's tests/cucumber/ harness, tests/common/ helpers (test_app.rs, test_client.rs), and a spec/ tree with one placeholder feature.
  - Use in-memory mock repositories — NEVER a real database in BDD tests.

Acceptance: `cargo make integ` (or `cargo test --test cucumber`) runs the placeholder feature green; no real I/O occurs in the test run.
title: [TPL-014] Add the BDD / cucumber test scaffold
